test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends, Gauri, Vinod, Ridima, Jiya, Ritik, Vishal and Karishma, are sitting on a circular bench, facing towards the centre but not necessarily in the same order. Vinod and Jiya are not the neighbours of Ritik. Karishma is sitting third to the left of Ritik. Gauri is sitting to the immediate right of Karishma. Ridima is sitting to the immediate left of Ritik. Who is sitting second to the right of Gauri?
solution:
Given: Seven friends, Gauri, Vinod, Ridima, Jiya, Ritik, Vishal and Karishma, are sitting on a circular bench, facing towards the centre.

1) Karishma is sitting third to the left of Ritik.

2) Gauri is sitting to the immediate right of Karishma.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ffd55fe5fb83284e07d3513cd162a884e8ecff72b346e4fc31072ed5f3d58a57.png] 

3) Ridima is sitting to the immediate left of Ritik.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0c85a2eb794b98e280602b6c68a61edc50de8d52975bad34666cff4fc2e91cc.png] 

4) Vinod and Jiya are not the neighbours of Ritik.

After positioning Vinod and Jiya only one position is left which will be occupied by only person left i.e. Vishal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cf882ca8ba357b49f1ef331d88974304f891b85b00faeab7b158034d36c2061.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Ritik is sitting second to the right of Gauri.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
